About Us:

Blockworks is an information platform that sits at the center of the crypto industry. We transform raw, complex data and facts into actionable research, trusted alpha-driven insights, and world-class events. The result is transparency and confidence. Blockworks connects investors and businesses in onchain capital markets. We give businesses a platform to earn trust and provide investors with the information they need to underwrite the asset class.

Who You Are

You are a strong product leader who wants to keep building products directly while developing other Product Managers. You have managed PMs before and know how to set a high bar, give direct feedback, and help people become stronger product leaders.

You stay close to customers and love to build. You work closely with Design and Engineering to break big bets into small releases that teach us something, and you believe great products come from continuous development grounded in the product vision and customer feedback.


What You’ll Do

As our Senior Product Manager, you will own a meaningful area of our product portfolio while managing three Product Managers who lead other products across Blockworks. Your specific product ownership will be shaped by your experience and where you can have the greatest impact.

  • Develop Product Managers: Set clear expectations and give direct feedback to help PMs grow while maintaining real ownership over their products.

  • Develop Product Strategy: Turn customer needs, company objectives, and market opportunities into clear priorities. Make difficult tradeoffs and keep teams focused on the highest-value problems.

  • Understand Our Customers: Spend time with exchanges, institutional investors, enterprises, and crypto companies to develop deep customer intuition and identify problems worth solving.

  • Raise the Product Bar: Improve how we build products at Blockworks by strengthening our discovery, prioritization, and internal processes. Create a more consistent product operating rhythm that helps teams ship faster, make better decisions, and act on feedback.

  • Ship and Iterate: Break ambitious ideas into focused releases that allow teams to learn quickly. Study product usage and gather customer feedback to identify what is and is not working, then continuously improve what we build.

Experimentation is frequent at Blockworks. Comfort with being uncomfortable is a must.


What You’ve Done Before

You have 4+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years directly managing Product Managers. You have helped PMs become stronger, more independent product leaders.

You are also a strong product builder. You have owned a meaningful product area from discovery through launch and can point to the decisions you made and outcomes you produced. In the age of AI, you are comfortable building prototypes that communicate your ideas quickly, without creating a time sink.

You have built enterprise software for sophisticated customers, ideally products that combine complex data, content, and workflows. You are comfortable working with APIs, data models, integrations, and other technical product considerations.

You have helped improve how a product team operates, whether through better discovery, feedback loops, planning, prioritization, or product development processes.


It’d Be Great If You’ve Done This

You have experience building products for institutional investors, asset managers, exchanges, or other financial market participants. Experience building products that sit directly inside an investor or analyst workflow is especially relevant, especially those that help with asset discovery and underwriting.

You understand crypto markets and how the industry operates. Direct experience building crypto products for institutional or professional users will move you toward the top of our list.

You have experience launching new products from zero to one or commercializing enterprise products alongside Sales and Marketing. You are comfortable thinking about how products make money, including building pricing models and packaging products.


Salary, Benefits, & How We Work

This is a full-time exempt position with an expected salary of $150,000 - $200,000.

Benefits:

Remote-First:

We're a remote-first organization with an office in NYC for you to utilize as you please.

100% Medical Coverage for You:

Close to fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you, and a significant portion covered for your dependents.

Flexible PTO:

We have a flexible paid time off policy that doesn't limit the number of vacation days you can take.

Parental Leave:

At Blockworks, all team members are eligible for 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

Hardware Stipend:

Every team member has a stipend to use to purchase the tools and technology that help them be their most productive.

Learning & Growth Stipend:

Every team member has a stipend to spend on their skill growth and professional development.

Career Growth:

We prioritize skill growth and career development, and we have a clear, documented structure to take the guesswork out of individual development and career progression

Global & Diverse Team:

We're a global team, and we're committed to creating an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

Come build with us; we're just getting started!

We know that diversity makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking. We are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encourage everyone to apply if your experience is close to what we are looking for.

Blockworks is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm work authorization.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a Technical Content Creator to showcase the practical power of Tether's peer-to-peer stack. This is a builder-centric role designed for an engineer or highly technical creator who bridges the gap between low-level infrastructure, cryptography, and functional application.

We are not looking for a social media marketer or an on-camera influencer. We are looking for a technical storyteller who can write code, spin up peer-to-peer nodes, build functional Bare-powered applications, and record polished, clear, screen-share demos. You will turn our core stack (Pear and Bare) into an ongoing series of visual, practical "build-in-public" prototypes that prove to the world what true decentralized, peer-to-peer infrastructure looks like.

Responsibilities

  • Build Practical Demos: Independently build functional peer-to-peer applications and infrastructure setups using the Pear platform and the Bare runtime with minimal engineering hand-holding.

  • Record Technical Demos: Record clear, engaging, and high-quality screen-share walkthroughs and video demos of your builds, highlighting how the code works, how peers discover and sync with each other, and the value the systems deliver.

  • Translate Code to Content: Turn complex protocol updates, cryptographic primitives, and technical documentation into highly visual, digestible developer content (such as code-along videos, step-by-step guides, and interactive repositories).

  • Collaborate with Core Devs: Work closely with our P2P protocol and product engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming Pear and Bare features.

  • Prototypes: Rapidly prototype application concepts — such as spinning up a peer-to-peer chat, file-sync, or data-replication demo — to show how quickly developers can launch resilient, serverless products using our ecosystem.

  • Fuel Influencer-Led Developer Adoption: Collaborate with technical influencers, developer advocates, and content creators to amplify our ecosystem. You will provide them with turn-key technical assets, co-create code-along challenges, and arm them with the high-quality demos and prototypes needed to inspire and onboard new developers to Pear and Bare.

  • 3 to 6+ years of experience in a technical role such as Technical Content Creation, Solutions Engineering, or Backend/Systems Development.

  • Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in languages used across our ecosystem (such as NodeJS, C/C++) to interact confidently with peer-to-peer networking and runtime internals.

  • Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, distributed systems, hypercore/append-only-log style data structures, and decentralized application architecture.

  • Demo/Video Production Skills: Experience recording and editing polished technical screen-shares, terminal recordings, or video tutorials (using tools like Loom, Camtasia, Screenflow, etc.).

  • Developer Empathy: The ability to look at a complex P2P protocol or runtime and understand exactly what kind of demo or sample project will get developers and infrastructure operators excited to start building.

  • Self-Starter Mindset: Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment across global time zones.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely last year and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, and Product teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. This is a key role where you will be uniquely positioned to impact the full picture of Ramp’s growth efforts through systems development.


What You'll Do

  • Own partner GTM systems: the roadmap, the architecture decisions inside them and their operational health

  • Build and deploy the Salesforce automation behind them: record-triggered and screen flows, validation rules, custom objects and fields, permission sets and approvals

  • Own partner attribution from first touch to payout: referral capture, deal registration, partner-to-opportunity linkage and monthly partner payouts

  • Own the integrations across the stack, including lead routing, sequence enrollment, meeting booking, enrichment and partner attribution, spanning Salesforce, LeanData, Outreach, Gong, Chili Piper, ZoomInfo and Workato

  • Prioritize incoming requests against ROI. Make the call on what gets built, what gets deferred and what gets declined, and show the numbers behind it

  • Drive cross-functional alignment on scope, sequencing and tradeoffs and carry it through to closure without a manager in the room

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years in business systems at a fast-paced company

  • Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on experience, plus real depth in HubSpot

  • Non-trivial Salesforce flows built and debugged when they broke, and a clear view of why declarative automation goes wrong at scale

  • A habit of framing problems rather than waiting for a spec: ambiguous requests taken on, decided and shipped

  • Fluency translating business requirements into a solution, and authoring that solution in terms of the outcome it drives and how that outcome will be measured

  • A metric-driven approach to prioritization: requests ranked on ROI, effort weighed against ongoing maintenance cost and the reasoning made explicit to the requester

  • Multi-month projects delivered with cross-team dependencies and no PM attached: sequencing the work, holding scope, flagging risk before it lands, clearing blockers rather than reporting them and keeping everyone informed without being asked

  • Fluency with AI tools to build, audit and document faster and a clear sense of where they stop being reliable


Nice to Have

  • Experience in channel or marketing systems: partner sourcing, revenue share and payouts, or campaign structure, UTM tracking, lead source and multi-touch attribution

  • Cross-functional program management across engineering, sales and finance stakeholders

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling: treating stakeholders as users, shipping in phases and measuring adoption after launch

  • Snowflake, Looker or similar BI and warehouse tooling

  • Working knowledge of Apex or Lightning Web Components, enough to recognize when declarative is the wrong answer

  • Linear or similar project management software

  • Time spent at a high-growth startup or technology company

The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next.

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

This isn't a typical internship.

CoinDCX Enterprise Business builds India's institutional gateway to crypto, working with prop trading desks, market makers, algo traders, and family offices that need compliant, scalable access to digital assets. Some of the firms in this pipeline run annual trading volumes of $1B+. A handful count among the fastest, most sophisticated high-frequency trading operations in the world, firms whose global desks move hundreds of billions of dollars a day.

You will work directly on how CoinDCX identifies, engages, and wins these clients. This means research, outreach, and problem-solving on live deals, not busywork on the side. You will sit close enough to the pipeline to see how a single well-timed reach-out to the right lead can turn into a client trading $5M+ a month.

You will help build the systems, relationships, and insight that turn a fragmented institutional market into a structured, repeatable pipeline, the kind of infrastructure that will still be running long after this first wave of institutional clients is onboarded.

What You'll Do

  • Research and map institutional prospects across prop desks, market makers, family offices, and algo trading firms, including some of the largest and most technically advanced trading operations globally * Generate and qualify leads, then run structured reach-outs to build relationships, spark interest, and move opportunities forward with founders, traders, and decision makers at these firms * Build and maintain structured databases and trackers that support scalable outreach and decision-making across the pipeline * Support GTM execution, from campaign and meeting planning to on-ground engagement * Track market, competitor, and regulatory developments relevant to institutional access to crypto in India * Translate client conversations into insight that shapes strategy, positioning, and product priorities

You'll Excel in This Role If You

  • Think in first principles and act like an owner * Are comfortable picking up the phone and starting a conversation with someone you've never met * Thrive in ambiguity and build structure where none exists * Communicate with clarity, whether in a client conversation or a written brief * Are analytical and enjoy working with data, trackers, and research * Have a bias for action and follow through without being chased * Want early exposure to how the world's most active trading firms think about markets, risk, and execution

You'll Know You're Winning When

  • You've built and are actively maintaining a live, structured database of institutional prospects, including some of the most sophisticated trading firms in the world * You've generated and worked leads through to high-ticket institutional clients, moving several conversations forward * Your research and briefs are being used by the team to make outreach and prioritisation decisions * You've identified at least one process or workflow improvement that the team has adopted

Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You

Institutional adoption of crypto in India is still being written, and CoinDCX is building the rails for it. This role puts you directly in that build, working alongside the people closing the first wave of institutional relationships in the country and engaging with some of the most demanding trading counterparties in any market, global high-frequency trading firms included.

You'll work with the Enterprise Business team, get exposure to real deals and real client conversations from week 1, and learn how a GTM motion is built from the ground up in a fast-moving market, at the pace and scale of firms that trade $1B+ a month.

Hiring Process

Application Review - We assess for skills, alignment, and intent

Recruiter Connect - A short conversation to understand you better

Functional Round(s) - Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving

Assignment / Simulation Round -

A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios

Culture & Values Discussion - A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best

Founder Conversation (Optional) - For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

Ready to Build What's Next?

If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

As a Senior Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Analyst, you’ll join our Investigation Operations (IO) team helping detect fraudulent activity, suspicious/illegal behaviors and patterns and drive projects focused on preventing and detecting financial crime. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, inquisitive individual with a background in AML compliance, who enjoys analytical challenges and is passionate about blockchain technology.

What you'll work on:

  • Investigating, analyzing and identifying activity which may lead to filing suspicious activity reports, as required by law, from AML alerts, enhanced monitoring reviews, and other L1 transaction monitoring reviews

  • Occasionally working cases, as-needed, and filing SARs/STRs when appropriate

  • Assisting in fulfilling requests from and providing support to, external parties, such as law enforcement and banking partners, and internal parties, such as policy, legal and Compliance Operations partners

  • Conducting screening and adverse media checks

  • Ensuring customers are compliant with the laws and regulations to satisfy Circle’s obligations to the appropriate regulatory authorities

  • Maintaining a strong operational focus with the ability to manage time sensitive workflows across competing priorities

  • Collaborate with policy and compliance data and technology teams to share trends and insights as well as provide suggestions to improve detection models, thresholds, and typology coverage to create greater efficiency and more valuable work products for the IO team

  • Ability to understand complex business problems, break down analytical projects into a structured approach and formalize complex ideas into a well defined logic

  • As needed, conduct training and provide feedback to TM analysts

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • A passion for harnessing the power of digital currency and blockchain technology and services built on top of it

  • B.A./B.S. degree; quantitative or technical degree a plus

  • 4+ years experience conducting AML alert review, investigation and applicable reporting, strong knowledge of AML regulations

  • Deep understanding of blockchain ecosystems, VASPs, and evolving global AML/CFT regulations

  • Extensive experience working with blockchain forensic tools (e.g., TRM Labs, Chainalysis, Elliptic)

  • Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with a close attention to detail and confidence to make a reasoned and supported decision

  • Experience analyzing large transactional data sets; SQL experience is a plus

  • Works well under pressure and tight deadlines with an ability to prioritize workloads and ensure tasks are completed in a timely manner

  • Experience and comfort working in an ever changing industry and the flexibility to quickly react to changing demands

  • Proven experience working collaboratively and effectively with the ability to work with multiple stakeholders and internal teams

  • CAMS, CFCS or CFE certification is a plus

  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Apple MacOS preferred

  • Interest and/or experience applying artificial intelligence, automation, or machine learning tools to optimize AML workflows, such as alert triage, data enrichment, and investigative analysis

This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year-on-year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, and others, and have recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Controller to build the next layer of Fleek’s finance function. This is a senior individual contributor role sitting within Finance, focused on creating a scalable controllership foundation in a business that has grown fast and now needs stronger process, rhythm, and control. You’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to design how accounting should operate as Fleek scales.

Why This Role Stands Out

At most companies, a Controller steps into an established finance function and improves it incrementally. At Fleek, you’ll be doing something much more interesting: building controllership in a company where the business has real scale and complexity, but parts of the accounting operating model still need to be designed from the ground up. In practice, that means you won’t just maintain processes, you’ll challenge them, rebuild them and create the operating cadence the company grows into.

This role is especially compelling for someone who has seen what “good” looks like in a larger or more mature environment, but also knows how to operate in the messiness of an early-stage company. Some systems already exist here. Some may need to be rethought entirely. The opportunity is to bring judgment, structure, and momentum to help establish the finance discipline that underpins the next phase of Fleek’s growth.

What Makes You a Fleek Controller?

  • Builder Mentality: You don’t just inherit processes, you redesign them when they’re not fit for purpose. You’re excited by the idea of creating a controllership function, not just running one.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You know how to operate when the company isn’t at zero-to-one, but the finance function partly is. Existing processes don’t intimidate you, even when they need to be torn down and rebuilt.

  • High Agency: You don’t wait for perfect alignment or clean inputs. You can drive an agenda, create momentum and push important operational changes through the organisation.

  • Influence Through Credibility: You can create buy-in outside finance, whether that’s around month-end discipline, information flows or better controls. People trust your judgment because it’s practical and grounded.

  • Scale-Informed: You’ve seen systems and accounting environments at scale, and you know how to apply that pattern recognition without becoming rigid or over-engineered.

What You'll Do

  • Build the Controllership Foundation: Design and establish the accounting processes, controls, and operating rhythm Fleek needs for its next phase of scale.

  • Redesign What Doesn’t Work: Assess existing systems and workflows, identify where they break down, and rebuild them where needed rather than patching around weak foundations.

  • Own the Month-End Operating Cadence: Create a cleaner month-end close rhythm across finance and partner teams, including stronger deadlines, accountability and information flow.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Discipline: Work with teams outside finance to improve the quality, timeliness, and consistency of inputs into the accounting process.

  • Bring Scale to an Early-Stage Environment: Use your experience from larger or more mature organisations to help Fleek build a finance function that is robust without becoming bureaucratic.

What You Bring

  • An accounting qualification such as CA, CCA, or CPA

  • Experience in scaled environments, such as MNCs, big tech, or similarly mature operating environments

  • Experience building accounting systems or processes from scratch, not just operating within established ones

  • Early-stage company exposure, even if your role there was not the most senior finance role

  • Strong stakeholder management and the ability to drive change outside the finance team

  • Good judgment on where to add structure versus where to stay lightweight

  • Remote or distributed team experience is a plus

  • Multi-entity experience is a plus

  • A data-driven or product-adjacent mindset is a plus

  • A genuine excitement for building something from scratch inside a fast-growing company.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, E1, Spitalfields / Shoreditch

  • Work model: In Person, with trust based flexibility

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India and Pakistan

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

What's In It for You?

Fleek is building the technology infrastructure for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally.

Why people join Fleek

  • The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. 17,400 tonnes of CO₂ avoided. Your work has tangible, measurable impact.

  • The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is the world's first LLM fine-tuned on secondhand fashion. This isn't a GPT wrapper, it's a proprietary model solving classification problems that don't exist anywhere else.

  • The growth is exceptional: tripling annually, backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others.

  • The timing is perfect: EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. The secondhand market is growing 3x faster than new fashion. You're catching a wave.

  • You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately.

Benefits

  • Equity / share options

  • Pension

  • Private health benefits

  • Learning and development budget

  • Team socials and offsites

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.
